title: Coronal Contrast-Enhanced CT of Acute Appendicitis
author: Goleisureintl
caption: Coronal contrast-enhanced CT scan of the abdomen and pelvis showing a dilated, thick-walled appendix with periappendiceal fat stranding.
alt_text: Coronal CT scan of the abdomen and pelvis demonstrating acute appendicitis in the right lower quadrant.
clinical_relevance: Contrasts terrestrial CT gold-standard imaging with spaceflight diagnostic constraints where CT is unavailable (CLIFF-032, p.5, p.7).
